title: THOUGHT BRANCHES: INTERPRETING LLM REASONING REQUIRES RESAMPLING

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in resume screening prompts using names stereotypically associated with White and Black individuals, followed by resampling analysis of the model's Chain-of-Thought to measure the causal effect of reasoning steps on interview decisions.

Counterfactual name substitution in resume screening prompts using stereotypically male and female names, evaluated via resampling and causal mediation analysis to uncover how implicit demographic information shifts the model's reasoning trajectory.
